signal: PingCAP unveiled TiDB X, a new serverless cloud-native core engine, at its TiDB SCaiLE event

email.body1:
Michael, saw PingCAP unveiled TiDB X, the new serverless engine, at TiDB SCaiLE.

A new platform release usually means more in-market strategic accounts in play than the team can cover before reps ramp, and that is where enterprise deals go cold. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for PingCAP off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress ~4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Michael, quick follow-up for PingCAP.

After a major launch, the strategic-accounts number tends to climb faster than the time a rep has to prospect it. Most teams don't actually know how many meetings they need to book to hit it, so the gap surfaces late and the quarter becomes a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings your accounts need to close that gap, and where the math breaks without more coverage.
email.body3:
Michael, last bit of proof for PingCAP.

Memgraph, also a database company, had more accounts in play than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how PingCAP's reply rate likely compares to other infra startups. Want to hop on a quick call and I'll walk you through it?
email.body4:
Michael, I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If covering more strategic accounts without adding headcount isn't a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Timing matters, and the post-launch stretch is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to a strategic-accounts motion? I'll tailor it to PingCAP either way.
